situation: Siblings planning a birthday outing for their mum.
topic: What are the opening hours of the Eden Project in Cornwall in December?

text: Thinking about a day out to the Eden Project in Cornwall for mum's bday. What are the opening hours in december? @claude

I couldn't confirm Eden's December daytime opening hours. The official page wouldn't load for me. The Christmas Lights evenings run on most December dates, and the Biomes close to day visitors at 3.15pm on those days. That comes from search results, not from a page I could open. Please check https://www.edenproject.com/visit/opening-times before you go.

https://www.edenproject.com/visit/whats-on/christmas-at-the-eden-project
